info.description:
# Maigie API

The backend for the **Maigie Intelligent Learning Environment**.

Maigie helps people and organisations continuously develop capability through personal learning, collaborative Learning Spaces, intelligent recommendations, and adaptive progress tracking.

## Domains

| Domain | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Identity** | Authentication, user profiles, preferences |
| **Knowledge** | Courses, modules, topics, resources |
| **Personal Learning** | Notes, exam prep, documents, study mode |
| **Learning Spaces** | Collaborative environments (membership, seats) |
| **Classrooms** | Structured learning within Spaces (sessions, discussions) |
| **Intelligence** | AI conversations, memory, recommendations |
| **Progress** | Analytics, streaks, spaced repetition, achievements |
| **Billing** | Subscriptions, credits, plans, referrals |
| **Admin** | Platform administration |

## Authentication

All authenticated endpoints require a `Bearer` token in the `Authorization` header.
Obtain tokens via `POST /api/v1/auth/login/json` or the OAuth flow.

Poll the status of a queued document generation job.

Only the learner who queued the job can read it. Unknown, expired, and
other learners' jobs are all reported as ``404`` so this endpoint cannot be
used to discover that another learner's job exists.
